scope: One World Trade Center, New York (detailed schematic)
title: One World Trade Center
blurb: The 1,776 ft tower by David Childs of SOM, tallest in the Western Hemisphere, opened in 2014. Eight isosceles triangles of prismatic glass rise from a 185 ft fortified base to a crown square rotated 45 degrees, topped by a 408 ft spire with its beacon at the symbolic height.

sourceUrls.label: Architectural Record: One World Trade Center (2012)
Architectural Record: One World Trade Center (2015)

systems.name: Fortified base and podium
systems.description: The 185 ft windowless concrete podium with 28 inch thick blast walls, glass fin cladding, four monumental entrances and the 55 ft lobby.

systems.name: Glass facade facets
systems.description: The four tapering glass faces of the chamfered tower, eight elongated isosceles triangles of prismatic curtain wall rising to the rotated crown.

systems.name: Chamfered corners
systems.description: The four chamfered corners with their slotted stainless steel detailing, growing from the square base to the crown square rotated 45 degrees.

systems.name: Concrete core
systems.description: The reinforced concrete shear wall core, 110 ft square with walls up to 4.5 ft thick, enclosing stairs, lifts and life safety systems.

systems.name: Structural frame
systems.description: The redundant steel moment frame at the perimeter, paired with the concrete core to resist progressive collapse.

systems.name: Mechanical floors
systems.description: Lower plant floors in the podium, the double height sky lobby, and the louvered upper mechanical levels below the observatory.

systems.name: Observatory
systems.description: One World Observatory on floors 100 to 102: the main viewing level, dining on 101, and the See Forever Theater on 102.

systems.name: Spire and broadcast ring
systems.description: The 408 ft sculpted spire on its circular support ring, with radome, communications ring, cable stays and the beacon at 1,776 ft.

systems.name: Vertical transportation
systems.description: Sky Pod elevators, destination dispatch banks, service and freight lifts, and the lobby escalators.

systems.name: Plaza and memorial context
systems.description: The World Trade Center plaza, the 9/11 Memorial pools and tree grove, surrounding streets, and below grade transit links.
